meta.name: aws-agentic-ai
meta.description: AWS Bedrock AgentCore comprehensive expert for deploying and managing all AgentCore services. Use when working with Gateway, Runtime, Memory, Identity, or any AgentCore component. Covers MCP target deployment, credential management, schema optimization, runtime configuration, memory management, and identity services.

copy.tagline: 在AWS上部署管理智能体服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在AWS上搭建和管理智能体服务
copy.tagline_en: Deploy and manage AI agent services on AWS
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy and manage AI agent services on AWS.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会依据 AWS 官方文档核实信息,并通过 AWS CLI 操作 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 的 Gateway、Runtime、Memory、Identity 等服务,负责部署、配置、凭证管理与监控等工作。
howto.when: 当涉及 AgentCore 相关任务时触发,例如部署 REST API 为 MCP 工具(Gateway)、执行无服务器智能体(Runtime)、添加对话记忆(Memory)等。

say.text: 帮我用 Gateway 把这个 REST API 部署成 MCP 工具。
say.note: Claude 会读取 Gateway 文档并执行部署流程。

say.text: 给智能体添加对话记忆功能。
say.note: Claude 会按 Memory 服务文档配置会话状态。

say.text: 如何为 AgentCore 的 API 密钥做凭证轮换?
say.note: Claude 会依据凭证管理文档给出轮换步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude verifies information against official AWS documentation and operates Amazon Bedrock AgentCore services (Gateway, Runtime, Memory, Identity, etc.) via AWS CLI, covering deployment, configuration, credential management, and monitoring.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working with AgentCore, e.g., deploying a REST API as an MCP tool (Gateway), running serverless agents (Runtime), adding conversation memory (Memory), etc.

say_en.text: Use Gateway to deploy this REST API as an MCP tool.
say_en.note: Claude reads Gateway docs and runs the deployment flow.

say_en.text: Add conversation memory to my agent.
say_en.note: Claude follows Memory service docs to configure state.

say_en.text: How do I rotate API keys for AgentCore credentials?
say_en.note: Claude provides rotation steps from the credential guide.
